name: Beat strip
summary: A beat is a moment in your scene. Pose a figure, press Add beat, and the scene clock moves on one second. Play runs the beats, smoothly, with Once, Loop or Yoyo.
helps: Make a figure move without a song: hand up, hand right, hand left, then play it back, scrub through it and set it to loop.

d2: Select a figure and pose it with its hand up.
Open the Animate panel and press Add beat. The clock moves on by one second.
Move the hand to the right and press Add beat. Move it to the left and press Add beat.
Press Play to watch it. Drag the slider to scrub. Press Stop to put the figure back.
Press the mode button to choose Once, Loop or Yoyo.
vr: Select a figure and pose it with its hand up.
Open the wrist menu, then Capture face, Animate, Beat strip.
Press Add beat. Move the hand right and press Add beat. Move it left and press Add beat.
Press Play. Tap a card to jump to that beat. Press Stop to put the figure back.
Press Loop mode to choose Once, Loop or Yoyo.
use: an unchanged pose is not added
the clock moves on by the gap after each beat, one second to start with
a look change takes at least 0.4 seconds, so nothing flashes
with a song playing, the beats follow the song's time
old keyframes turn into beats and stay as they were
a friend watches what the host plays and cannot change the beats.

changes.note: You can now make a figure move without a song, so pose it, press Add beat, move it, press Add beat again, then Play, and use Loop mode to choose Once, Loop or Yoyo.
